TAP::config
       Returns the current value of the specified setting in an assigned TAP Application.

SYNOPSIS
       TAP::config APPLICATION ENTITY

DESCRIPTION
       Returns the current value of the specified setting in an assigned TAP Application.

RETURN VALUE
       Returns the current value of the specified setting in an assigned TAP Application.

VALID DURING
       ANY_EVENT

EXAMPLES
HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-15.0.0 --First introduced the command.
